changelog: Combined Smart-To-Do with AntiBot to create an autonomous Personal AI Assistant
Screen Vision & Control: Point & Draw over screen (Circle-to-Search) to ask AI about any region, full screen reading, and autonomous gestures via Accessibility
Multi-Tool Floating Palette: Replaced single panel with expandable 6-in-1 tool palette (Draw Screen, Read Screen, Smart Tasks, Quick Actions, Share, Chat)
Device Automation Dispatcher: Voice and text commands to set alarms, timers, make phone calls, send SMS messages, and toggle flashlight
Smart Tasks & Notes Fusion: Offline SQLite task manager with priority badges, recurring schedules, exact reminder alarms, and NotesScreen tab integration

Universal Cross-Device Share: UDP LAN discovery on port 43884 (SyncTask compatible) + Zero-Install Local Web Drop (HTTP port 5234) for PC/iPhone/Android file exchange without installing apps + Bluetooth beam
Human-Like Conversational Voice & Live Subtitles: Natural TTS cadence with markdown filtering and floating on-screen live subtitle captions
